input_messages.content: Hi, I'm having trouble sending MMS messages using my messaging app for the past few hours. I'm currently abroad in France. Can you help me fix this?
Sure, my name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002.

My status bar shows that Airplane Mode is on, and the battery is at 80%. The network status confirms that Airplane Mode is on, my SIM card is missing, there is no cellular service or signal, mobile data is disabled, and data roaming is also disabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. What should I do next?
I turned Airplane Mode off. Now my status bar shows no signal and data is disabled, with the battery still at 80%. What should I do next?
I have reinserted the SIM card, and it is now active and working. The status bar shows a poor signal with 2G network and data disabled. What should I do next?

I turned mobile data on and enabled data roaming. The network status now shows my SIM card is active, cellular connection is connected but with poor signal, network type is 2G, mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is enabled. What should I try next?

My network mode preference was set to 2G only. I changed it to 4G/5G preferred. Now my status bar shows excellent signal with 5G network, and the network status confirms the same with mobile data and data roaming enabled. What should I do next?
The speed test failed, showing no connection, and my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. It seems the data limit of 15 GB has been reached. What can I do to fix this?
I don't want to change my mobile data plan. Please refuel 2.0 GB of data for me.
Before proceeding with the refuel, could you please initiate the refuel of 2.0 GB data for me? I am ready to confirm the payment once the request is sent.
The speed test now shows an excellent connection with 275 Mbps, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I try next?
The APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". Both seem to be correctly configured. What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling was ON, but I turned it OFF. However, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try?
The messaging app had permission for storage but was missing permission for SMS. I granted the SMS permission, and now the app can send MMS messages. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you very much for your help and thorough support. I appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###

Thanks, John. I found your line, 555-123-2002. Roaming was off on it, so I've turned it on at no cost, since you're in France.

Your line has also used 15.1 GB of its 15 GB monthly limit. That can cut off mobile data, and MMS needs mobile data. I'll come back to that.

First, I'd like to check a few things on your phone:
1. Please check your status bar. Tell me whether Airplane Mode is on, what the signal strength is, and whether Data is enabled.
2. Please check your network status. Tell me whether mobile data is enabled and whether Data Roaming is enabled on the phone.

The network status confirms that Airplane Mode is on, my SIM card is missing, there is no cellular service or signal, mobile data is disabled, and data roaming is also disabled. 1. **Refuel data.** You can add up to 2 GB at once. Your Premium Plan charges $2.00 per GB, so 1 GB costs $2.00 and 2 GB costs $4.00. The charge is added to your bill.
